title: Violation Tree Witness Alternatives
description: The violation tree should use tree alternatives (branch navigation < 1/N >) when having multiple witnesses under a parent node, instead of showing all witnesses as flat children.
summary: Modified ValidationTreeNodeView to use tree branch navigation (< 1/N >) when a node has multiple witness children. Non-witness children render normally while witnesses are navigable via alternatives. Added MultipleWitnessAlternatives story with 3 witnesses. Type-check, vitest (22/22), and storybook build all pass.
